meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交前自动运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在提交或创建PR前需要强制验证测试通过
copy.tagline_en: Run verification commands and confirm output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce verification before committing or creating PRs

howto.what: 在你声称任务完成、已修复或测试通过之前，Claude 会先实际运行对应的验证命令，读取完整输出和退出码，只有拿到新证据才下结论；没有证据就不做任何成功声明。
howto.when: 当你要提交代码、创建 PR、宣告任务完成，或准备说“通过/修好了”之前接管；委托子代理并收到成功汇报后也适用。

say.text: 我改完了，先跑一遍测试再确认是不是真的通过。
say.note: 会实际运行测试并核对输出，再下结论。

say.text: 提交之前帮我验证构建和 lint 是否真的没问题。
say.note: 看到退出码和完整输出后才算数。

say.text: 子代理说搞定了，独立验证一下实际改动。
say.note: 会检查版本控制差异，不直接采信汇报。

howto.what_en: Before claiming work is complete, fixed, or passing, Claude first runs the actual verification command, reads the full output and exit code, and only makes a claim when fresh evidence confirms it.
howto.when_en: Use it before committing, creating a PR, or saying work is done, fixed, or passing; also after a delegated agent reports success.

say_en.text: I'm done — run the tests again and confirm they actually pass.
say_en.note: Runs the tests and checks the real output first.

say_en.text: Verify the build and lint pass before I commit.
say_en.note: Checks exit code and full output, not assumptions.

say_en.text: The agent says it succeeded — verify the changes independently.
say_en.note: Inspects the VCS diff instead of trusting the report.
